tasks.title: Route session stream events to session_stream_log in acp-session.ts
tasks.description: In acp-session.ts, add SESSION_STREAM_EVENT_TYPES constant set. At both write sites (runAcpSession line ~246 and createAcpConnection line ~663), replace the unconditional workflowLogRepo.insert with routing logic: if eventType is in SESSION_STREAM_EVENT_TYPES, write to sessionStreamLogRepo; otherwise write to workflowLogRepo. The routing reads sessionStreamLogRepo from the respective options object (AcpSessionOptions for runAcpSession, AcpConnectionOptions for createAcpConnection). writeSessionLog helper (lifecycle events) continues unchanged.
